title: Improve conditional kappa to 0.00171614042599744 by composing concentrated assignments and pre-life hosting
body:

The complete rational is in `CLAIM.json`; the selected repository result is unchanged.

The contribution regenerates both actual words, all anticipatory corrections and inverse cleanup, then applies two explicit helper maps to the actual owner fill. It has 415 helpers, 72 private FULL buffers and 276,390 owner roles. Physical stock is 66,801, with every restoration, buffer and idle charge included. The complete native profile changes by `4662*(H5 + 2*H2 - 3*H3)`; strict Jensen proves a smaller native moment for every `0 < p < 1`.

An independently checked rational dual/lattice certificate bounds the fixed-inventory endpoint by `.0017161404259975`, within `5.8483811e-17` of the certified candidate endpoint. This is a scoped ceiling, not an exact packing optimum or a bound for changed words/contracts.
